t: The Brenner Mould and Mildew Remover 1Ltr is a fast-acting liquid designed to clear stubborn mould stains and disinfect surfaces. This ready-to-use, low-odour formula is ideal for walls and tiles in damp kitchens and bathrooms. The bleach-free solution contains low chemical emissions, making it safe for regular cleaning. This treatment removes spores and helps prevent mould from returning, keeping professional jobs clean and easy to maintain.
